title: Service Cloud Voice – Channel Setup & IVR Flow
description: Provision QSR toll-free number on Service Cloud Voice (Amazon Connect OEM or BYOT). Build Service Cloud Voice Flow: greeting, role capture (Franchisee/Store Manager/Store Operator), category capture (Order/Driver/Complaint/Item), FID/store-phone lookup, Omni-Channel route. IVR disclosure for call recording. After-hours branch to voicemail.
notes: Dependent on number provisioning lead time (Amazon Connect OEM vs BYOT decision open). Existing SF org – no greenfield setup.
epic_name: Service Cloud Voice – Channel Setup & IVR Flow

title: Omni-Channel QSR Skill & Routing Config
description: Create QSR skill in Salesforce Omni-Channel. Configure skill-based routing rules, agent presence, capacity config, and queue operating hours. Configure 3 warm-transfer queues: AJ Claessens (backend escalation), Spark driver support, Compliance on-call. Callback queue config.
notes: Coverage hours decision open (24/7 vs 5am–11pm CT). Spanish bilingual coverage TBD – may require additional skill/overflow config. Compliance on-call queue does not exist today.

title: Voice Call → Case Linkage & Service Console Layout
description: Salesforce Flow on Voice Call Accepted: match open Case by phone/FID/30-day window, link if found, auto-create tagged QSR-Voice + category if not. Service Console layout: header strip (role, category, FID/Store ID, linked Case + 30-day timeline), category-driven sub-tab switching. Omni-Channel widget + LMD disposition picklist in Console. Cross-channel case timeline (email + voice, 30 days).
notes: Builds on existing Service Console. Case dedup match key (FID + phone + 30-day window) needs validation. LMD picklist: LMD650/651/652 + Complaint/Item/Other. Validation rule blocks Case save if disposition empty.
epic_name: Voice Call → Case Linkage & Service Console Layout

title: Order Lookup Lightning Component + OMS Integration
description: Custom Lightning component embedded in Service Console for Order category sub-tab. Query OMS by order ID / customer name / FID + time-window. Display POS-received status, Subway API adapter timestamp, driver-assigned status. Enables live LMD652 disposition. Requires Apex callout or External Services to OMS + Subway API adapter.
notes: Highest complexity item. Requires API contract from Michelle Fultz (OMS) and Subway API adapter. Two external system integrations. Auth, error handling, field mapping all TBD. ASSUMED: REST/JSON APIs available.
epic_name: Order Lookup Lightning Component + OMS Integration

title: Driver Lightning Component + LMD Un-batch API Integration
description: Custom Lightning component for Driver category sub-tab: current assigned driver, ETA, wait-time-so-far. One-click Un-batch request action via Salesforce Flow/Apex → LMD un-batch API. Warm-transfer action to Spark driver support queue via Omni-Channel. Driver behavior/safety report path.
notes: LMD un-batch API contract needed from Edwin Ortiz. Spark driver systems API for ETA/assignment status. Two external APIs. ASSUMED: callout latency acceptable within console UX.
epic_name: Driver Lightning Component + LMD Un-batch API Integration

title: Complaint Intake Lightning Form + Allergen P0 Fast-Track
description: Custom Lightning form for Complaint category sub-tab: type (food quality/missing item/cold food/wrong order/driver behavior/allergen), severity, customer contact, action taken. Auto-populates linked Case fields; sets RecordType=Complaint. Allergen/food-safety checkbox triggers Salesforce Flow P0 alert to Compliance + Partner Services on-call queue within 15 min. Validation rule blocks Case-close until Compliance acknowledgement field checked.
notes: Compliance on-call queue does not exist today – must be created. 15-min SLA Flow build. Complaint hand-back policy to Customer Care not yet written (Open Q9). Allergen path is regulatory (P0).
epic_name: Complaint Intake Lightning Form + Allergen P0 Fast-Track

title: Item Signal Lightning Form + Catalog/Adapter Routing
description: Custom Lightning form for Item category sub-tab: item ID/name, issue type (OOS/wrong-price/wrong-image/modifier-not-supported/not-carried-here), duration (right-now/today/ongoing). On save: child Case auto-created and routed via Omni-Channel or Salesforce Flow to Subway API adapter team + catalog team queue.
notes: Item Signal triage owner not yet decided (Open Q8: PS vs catalog vs Subway adapter). Queue config pending owner decision. P1 – can be deferred to Phase 2 if needed.

title: Call Recording, Shield Event Monitoring & Compliance Config
description: Configure Service Cloud Voice call recording per Walmart policy. IVR greeting disclosure script. Retention period configuration. Salesforce Shield event monitoring on Voice Call + Case objects for full audit trail. No PCI data in scope.
notes: Compliance/Legal (TBD) to supply disclosure script + retention period. Shield may require separate licensing confirmation.
epic_name: Call Recording, Shield Event Monitoring & Compliance Config

title: Callback / Voicemail Fallback + 4-hr SLA Flow
description: Configure Native Service Cloud Voice in-queue callback (Press 1 to hold place + get callback). After-hours voicemail transcribed to Case. Salesforce Flow enforces 4-hr callback SLA and creates follow-up tasks for agents.
notes: Coverage hours decision (Open Q1) impacts when SLA clock starts. Native SCV capability – config + Flow automation.

title: Einstein Conversation Insights + Post-Call Auto-Summary
description: Enable real-time voice transcription via Service Cloud Voice. Configure Einstein Conversation Insights for post-call auto-summary appended to Case.Description. Agent review + edit before save. Optional: Einstein auto-tags LMD code / complaint type / item ID from transcript.
notes: Einstein for Service licensing required (Open Q12). Optional per PRD. QSR/restaurant domain accuracy may need tuning. Dependent on Einstein license procurement.

title: Reporting: Voice + Case Metrics + LMD Dashboard Data Pipe
description: Native Salesforce reports on Voice Call + Case objects: call volume by category, disposition-code volume, average AHT by category, LMD650/651/652 rate, complaint-severity mix, item-signal volume by store. Data pipe or CRM Analytics connector to Power BI LMD Dashboard.
notes: Power BI data pipe / CRM Analytics connector config needed. Scope with Salesforce platform team. Reporting objects are native – effort is in report design + data pipe config.
epic_name: Reporting: Voice + Case Metrics + LMD Dashboard Data Pipe

title: UAT, Agent Training & Go-Live Readiness
description: End-to-end UAT across all 4 inquiry categories (Order/Driver/Complaint/Item) and IVR paths. Agent training on QSR voice skill: order-flow, 3 LMD codes, driver/un-batch, complaint handling, item signalling. Store-associate pilot testing (2 CT Subway stores). Phone number publishing to Seller Center welcome kit + store signage.
notes: WFM/CES owns training curriculum. UAT requires Walmart QA resources + pilot store participation. Go/no-go decision gate before live calls.
